FR-001.title: The point-of-sale navigation destination MUST open a list of sales, replacing the capture surface

FR-002.title: The list MUST show reference/folio, date and time, customer, status, total and outstanding balance

FR-003.title: The list MUST be scoped to the cashier's own point of sale and default to the current trading day

FR-004.title: The list MUST offer date-range, status and free-text search filters, and MUST page results

FR-005.title: The list MUST order sales newest first

FR-006.title: The list MUST offer an edit action only on sales that are still workable

FR-007.title: Edit MUST open the workspace at the step the sale's status and delivery destination imply

FR-008.title: The list MUST offer a primary action that starts a new sale and opens the workspace on it

FR-009.title: Returning to the list from the workspace MUST re-read the sales

FR-010.title: The list MUST report empty, loading and failure states per convention, with retry

FR-011.title: The list MUST remain inside the application shell with the existing access gate

FR-012.title: The sale workspace MUST render full-screen with its own app bar and no rail or drawer

FR-013.title: The workspace app bar MUST carry a Back affordance that returns to the list

FR-014.title: The workspace app bar area MUST carry the sale reference, folio and step indicator

FR-015.title: The workspace MUST NOT centre or width-bound its content

FR-016.title: The workspace MUST leave no unused vertical space; the lines region absorbs it

FR-017.title: All three steps MUST render inside the workspace in the order spec 020 fixed

FR-018.title: Leaving the workspace with a sale that has no lines MUST abandon that draft

FR-019.title: Opening a sale that cannot be worked on MUST explain and offer a way back, opening no sale

FR-020.title: The cash-session gate MUST govern the workspace on every entry path

FR-021.title: At phone widths the workspace MUST keep the stacked single-scroll capture behaviour

FR-022.title: The customer band MUST by default report name, credit line, price list and balance as information

FR-023.title: The customer band MUST always show the resolved customer name, including mid-change

FR-024.title: The customer band MUST offer search and create actions, create only when permitted

FR-025.title: Pressing search MUST replace the facts in place with the picker, with a visible transition and focus

FR-026.title: Dismissing the picker without choosing MUST restore the facts and change nothing

FR-027.title: The band MUST show progress while fetching candidates and while attaching a customer

FR-028.title: The segmented immediate/credit control MUST be replaced by a payment-terms dropdown by the credit line

FR-029.title: The terms dropdown MUST show the sale's terms, offer credit only with a credit line, and state its absence

FR-030.title: The screen MUST NOT change payment terms other than in response to the cashier choosing them

FR-031.title: The fulfilment mode control MUST sit beside the customer band where width allows, below it otherwise

FR-032.title: The customer band MUST span its available width with token insets and no nested padding

FR-033.title: The product field MUST offer matching products as the cashier types, debounced, without Enter

FR-034.title: The product field MUST keep the scanner path: code plus Enter with one match adds the line directly

FR-035.title: Only the result for the currently typed text MUST be offered

FR-036.title: The product field MUST show search progress, state no-match, and allow dismissal without clearing text

FR-037.title: A sale line MUST render as one row above a defined width, two rows below it, and the card at phone widths

FR-037a.title: The single-row width MUST be low enough that a tablet in landscape (1024 px) uses one row

FR-038.title: Each of a line's fields MUST be sized for the value it holds, product area taking the remainder

FR-039.title: A line MUST present the product name prominently with the code as a secondary line beneath

FR-040.title: A line MUST reserve a fixed thumbnail slot rendering the placeholder until a backend photo exists

FR-041.title: A line MUST keep warehouse choice, availability and the non-blocking shortfall warning

FR-042.title: A line of a non-editable sale MUST render values legibly with every control inert

FR-043.title: The footer MUST report item and unit counts, subtotal, discounts when any, and tax as labelled figures

FR-044.title: The footer MUST set the grand total apart as its most prominent, right-aligned figure with currency

FR-045.title: The footer MUST carry the advancing action on the same band, disabled until the sale can advance

FR-046.title: The footer MUST stay visible without scrolling at every supported width

FR-047.title: Every figure the footer reports MUST come from the sale as returned, never recomputed

FR-048.title: All colour, spacing, radius, elevation and text size MUST come from design tokens via the theme

FR-049.title: Changed controls MUST meet touch-target and contrast rules per form factor and be keyboard-reachable

FR-050.title: Every label, message and empty state introduced MUST exist in both supported locales

FR-051.title: Restyled shared components MUST have their visual reference images refreshed
